project.name: Inspecto — geo map + link analysis routes (Standard edition, optional)
project.description:
OPTIONAL Standard-edition control-plane route groups (EDITIONS.md CP-09, "Geo map + link analysis"): GeoRoutes (/geo/projection, /geo/routes) and InvRoutes (/inv/projection, /inv/projection/neighbors, /inv/schema/relationships), contributed through the core's public com.gamma.control.RouteModule ServiceLoader seam (EDG-01 cell 3a) and registered AFTER the core's built-in route list.
WHY THIS MODULE EXISTS (EDG-01 cell 3b, 2026-09-07). CP-09 was decided "not for Personal" on 2026-09-02 and both route groups nonetheless shipped in every bundle because they sat in the core. Dropping THIS jar on the classpath is what makes the five paths exist; without it the core answers them with 503 "not installed" (AbsentGeoLinkRoutes) and /bootstrap reports features.geoLink=false, on which the SPA hides the two nav entries and the two widget offers.
THIN, like inspecto-policy: nothing beyond what the core already supplies (the query engine, the component/view stores, Jackson), so there is no shade and no sidecar classifier.
Built only under the "edition-standard"/"edition-enterprise" profiles (see the parent pom's profile-scoped <modules>), so a routine "mvn -o clean test" (= Personal, the DEFAULT build -- there is no -Pedition-personal) never compiles or tests it.
